strengths.I006: Uses concrete executed-check outcomes as repair feedback and compounds across runs through a template library, which is something a lone agent cannot have.
strengths.I004: Stands alone. It gives the developer independent judges' loss reasons, holds the revision to the same length, and accepts it only if a judge from a different model family prefers it in both orders. A no-reasons control arm isolates the effect of the loss reasons, at about +25% cost.

verdicts.reason: I006 assumes the whole I005 claim-ledger infrastructure already exists, roughly doubles development tokens and carries 7 open major critiques. I004 is a self-contained one-week sub-phase at about +25% cost.

strengths.I008: Explicitly models and subtracts each judge's position bias and self-preference, weights judges by how well they predict external raters, and adds no tokens at equal vote budget.
strengths.I004: Changes the ideas themselves by repairing weaknesses that independent judges cited. Length matching and two-order gating protect it from verbosity and position bias.

verdicts.reason: I008 can be switched on and off by offline refits on saved runs and scored by held-out agreement with external rankings (Kendall tau) at equal vote count. I004 needs new runs and shows its effect mainly through panel opinion.

strengths.I006: Adds a bounded execution-feedback repair loop and a reusable cross-run check library, so later runs parameterise existing checks instead of improvising them.
strengths.I005: Replaces persuasive critic prose with falsifiable claims decided by sandbox scripts and library lookups, closing the eloquence channel at both critique and selection. It has a clean prose/ledger switch.

verdicts.reason: I006 is built on top of I005's ledger, so it cannot be tested without it. It also costs about twice the development tokens and has more open major critiques, while I005 is the cheaper prerequisite at +30-50% critique tokens.

strengths.I003: A roughly 60-line scoring-only change that can be tested fully by offline replay on saved records. It targets best-of-3 value by penalising correlated same-lever duplicates.
strengths.I004: Improves the finalists' content with an independent adversary's loss reasons. A length-matched, both-order, different-family verifier gate means accepted changes cannot win on verbosity or position.

verdicts.reason: I003 only reshuffles already-scored finalists and by construction can lose on mean-of-3, with a cluster-correlation tau chosen ad hoc. I004 raises the quality of the finalists themselves through independent loss feedback under a bias-controlled acceptance gate.
